'''Terrence Gong''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[June 2000 San Jose tournament (10 June)]] on 10 June 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|"Iron Mike" Profit]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d872">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ san-jose-ca-6-11], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-san-jose-ca-6-11d872/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
